page.layout: Digitiser's cover sheet, one column: e-rara logo at top right; centred title block; below a rule, multilingual access and terms notices; Visual Library logo bottom right.
page.notes: No printed page of the book is on this scan. It is the e-rara.ch / Universitätsbibliothek Basel digitiser's cover sheet, left out under rule 6. Its content, for reference only: title "In Davidis Psalterium sacrosanctum commentarii", author "Musculus, Wolfgang", place and date "Basileae, [1618]", shelf mark FNP II 27:1, and a persistent link. The licence and terms-of-use notices in German, English, French and Italian are also digitiser text, not book text.
